children: Apnimed reported net income of $125.9 million for Q2 2026 and ended the quarter with $172.8 million in cash and cash equivalents. The company announced the FDA accepted its NDA for AD109 (proposed proprietary name Oxnimbi) with a PDUFA target action date of February 28, 2027, and completed an upsized IPO raising $220.8 million of gross proceeds. R&D and G&A trends reflected completed Phase 3 trials and increased commercial readiness spending, respectively.
Net income: $125.9 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (compared to net loss of $69.5 million in Q2 2025).
Cash and cash equivalents: approximately $172.8 million as of June 30, 2026.
Revenue - related party: $12.08 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026; $96.894 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
Research and development expense: $9.9 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (down from $16.0 million in Q2 2025).
General and administrative expense: $12.7 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (up from $5.4 million in Q2 2025).
FDA accepted the NDA for AD109 (proposed proprietary name Oxnimbi) for adults with obstructive sleep apnea and assigned a PDUFA date of February 28, 2027.

Completed two Phase 3 trials (SynAIRgy and LunAIRo) and presented pooled analyses and related research at ATS 2026 and SLEEP 2026; published Phase 3 results and a mechanistic review in peer-reviewed journals.
Completed strategic monetization of interest in Shionogi-Apnimed Sleep Science, generating $100 million in upfront proceeds and potential additional milestone and royalty payments.

Completed an upsized initial public offering for gross proceeds of $220.8 million and commenced trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on July 31, 2026; also entered a senior secured credit facility for up to $150 million.

Strengthened leadership with appointments of a new CEO, CFO and Chief Legal Officer / Head of Corporate Affairs as part of a planned transition and advanced commercial readiness activities in preparation for a potential U.S. launch.
